label: Container Battery State
info:
ContainerBatteryState - BCU J1939 CAN Protocol

CAN Messages:
- 0x18FF14F0: Battery Status (SOC, SOH, Energy)
- 0x18FF11F0: Cell Status (Voltage, Current, Temp)
- 0x18FF12F0: Max/Min Voltage Status
- 0x18FF10F0: State Message (State, DMCC, DMDC)
- 0x18FF13F0: Status2 (Temp Locations, OutVolt)
